items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: No more than what Ewe Smith told me that, I think he said he died in his sleep.

ctx.x: So, let's go back to Slim. When, when, how, do you know anything about how, we'll get to a few things, how Slim, how Slim died?

No, I don't. No more than what Ewe Smith told me that, I think he said he died in his sleep. I really don't know about his death too much. I really don't know. But he was in Ohio. I don't know. Slim was a heavy drinker. Very heavy drinker. And of course I'm quite sure after he started making heavy money, I guess he started drinking heavy, you know. But I think they find him in the sleeper. I'm almost sure. I wouldn't, I wouldn't, I wouldn't bet on him, but I think this way it was. Because he was in Ohio, and I…
Do you know anything about his family?
